# spoke_static_target_bindings (Data Source)

Discover a complete bounded publication collection. Reads are observational. A missing parent or denied scope is an error; it cannot prove child absence.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Parent loss is an error, not an empty child collection.
data "spoke_static_target_bindings" "site" {
  application_id = "123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Exact parent application ID. The API exposes reservations only through this parent collection.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Explicit scoped collection identity.
- `items` (Attributes List) One complete bounded, authorized snapshot. Partial or stale results are never exposed as absence. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `application_id` (String) Exact application ID in this project; changing it requires replacement and a new management_key.
- `environment_id` (String) Destination environment identifier. Changing it requires replacement and a new management_key.
- `id` (String) Canonical import identity: organization_id/project_id/binding_id.
- `resource_id` (String) Exact reservation ID supplied to an environment target.
- `revision` (String) Observed reservation revision, including consumption/cancellation transitions.
- `state` (String) Observed reserved, consumed or cancelling state.
- `target_id` (String) Nullable consuming target ID. A missing/denied child read cannot release this reservation.
